before: About five single-rope rappels, roughly 400 ft total, down the rock rib beside the snow couloir - another account puts the same line at five or six single-rope rappels back to the snowfield. Three is reported in good early-season snow, when much of the couloir is downclimbed instead, and six to seven in dry late-season conditions when the snow has pulled back off the rock. All of these are single-rope figures; two ropes roughly halves them. Do not reverse the Northeast Face itself.
